search_text: published ZDI-20-1438 ZDI-CAN-11359 (0Day) D-Link DCS-960L HTTP Authorization Header Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2020-12-15 8.8 AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['D-Link'] ['DCS-960L'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DCS-960L Wi-Fi cameras. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the HTTP server, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. A crafted Authorization header in an HTTP request can trigger an overflow of a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device. title: (0Day) D-Link DCS-960L HTTP Authorization Header Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DCS-960L Wi-Fi cameras. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the HTTP server, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. A crafted Authorization header in an HTTP request can trigger an overflow of a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device.
